summary: 63 pytest cases cover all TDD anchors from task-2.md plus additional coverage: 3 CSP assertions (exact string, substrings, in-head position), 10 allowed-tag rendering cases, 6 bad-attr-name variants (parametrised), URL-scheme filter across js/data/vbscript/file/relative/empty/leading-whitespace/uppercase/http/https, Cyrillic round-trip in both text and attributes, HTML parseability via stdlib html.parser as a belt-and-suspenders structural check. No skipped tests, no xfails, no bare `assert mock.called`.

findings.description: test_other_unknown_tags_dropped[style] has a carve-out for </style> because the renderer emits a legitimate inline <style> for readability. The carve-out is documented inline.
findings.recommendation: Acceptable; the tested invariant (payload absence) holds unconditionally.
